skill.name: seo-structure-architect
skill.description: Designs SEO-friendly content architecture by reviewing heading hierarchy, schema opportunities, internal links, and page flow.
skill.summary: Creates practical content structure blueprints for search-friendly pages and topic clusters.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The flagged backticks are Markdown formatting for a path and a header outline example, not executable shell calls. The LocalBusiness text is an SEO schema type, not network reconnaissance; no prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 25 uses inline Markdown backticks around a documentation file path. It does not request shell execution or run Ruby code.
Lines 79-85 are a fenced Markdown example showing an H1-H3 content outline. The block contains no command, script, or executable instruction.

content.value_statement: Content pages lose search value when headings, schema, and links are unplanned. This skill turns raw topics into clear structures for users and search engines.
actual_capabilities: Reviews H1-H6 hierarchy and recommends clearer section flow.
Creates page structure blueprints with main sections and subsections.
Suggests relevant schema types such as Article, FAQ, HowTo, and BreadcrumbList.
Identifies internal linking opportunities across related content clusters.
Recommends table of contents, breadcrumb, and jump link structures.
Formats content plans for featured snippet and scannability goals.
limitations: Does not crawl websites or inspect live pages without supplied content.
Does not provide keyword volume, backlink, or ranking data.
Schema recommendations still need developer review before publishing.
Search performance depends on content quality, authority, and technical SEO.

use_cases.title: Plan a New SEO Article
use_cases.description: Turn a target topic into a clean heading outline, schema plan, and internal link map.

use_cases.title: Improve Existing Page Structure
use_cases.description: Audit a current page outline and find weak hierarchy, missing sections, and better link targets.

use_cases.title: Define Technical Content Markup
use_cases.description: Translate content structure into breadcrumb, table of contents, and structured data requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Simple Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page outline for SEO structure. Check the H1, H2, and H3 hierarchy, then suggest a cleaner version.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Page Blueprint
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO content structure blueprint for this topic. Include headings, table of contents sections, schema opportunities, and internal link ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Topic Cluster
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a topic cluster for these related pages. Show parent and child relationships, internal link priorities, and breadcrumb recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Content Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this site section for content architecture. Identify hierarchy issues, silo gaps, schema coverage, featured snippet opportunities, and implementation priorities.

output_examples.input: A blog draft about choosing project management software with uneven H2 and H4 headings.
output_examples.output: A revised H1-H3 outline, recommended FAQ and Article schema, stronger comparison sections, and internal links to buying guides.

output_examples.input: A service page for a local accounting firm with no table of contents or breadcrumb plan.
output_examples.output: A clearer service page structure, LocalBusiness and BreadcrumbList schema suggestions, jump links, and related service links.

output_examples.input: A set of articles about home solar installation, costs, rebates, and maintenance.
output_examples.output: A topic cluster map with pillar and supporting pages, cross-link rules, URL structure guidance, and snippet-ready section formats.

best_practices: Provide the current outline, target topic, audience, and publishing platform.
Ask for separate recommendations for headings, schema, links, and snippets.
Review schema and implementation advice with your CMS or engineering team.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to guarantee rankings or traffic gains.
Do not use schema suggestions without checking policy and technical validity.
Do not treat keyword stuffing as a substitute for logical information flow.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It optimizes content structure, heading hierarchy, schema opportunities, internal links, breadcrumbs, and table of contents planning.

faq.question: Can it create schema markup ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend suitable schema types such as Article, FAQ, HowTo, LocalBusiness, and BreadcrumbList.

faq.question: Does it run SEO crawls?
faq.answer: No. It works from the content, outlines, URLs, and site context that you provide.

faq.question: Is it useful for existing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can audit an existing outline and propose clearer headings, links, schema coverage, and snippet-friendly sections.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it replace technical SEO review?
faq.answer: No. It supports content architecture planning, but technical validation and publishing checks remain necessary.
